items.description: Items is the list of the requests.

nextCursor.description: NextCursor is set when more requests are available.

SupportRequestList.title: Support Request List
SupportRequestList.description: SupportRequestList is the response of the ListSupportRequest method.

id.description: ID is the unique identifier of the request.

number.description: Number is the human-readable number of the request (e.g. 1042).

subject.description: Subject is the subject of the request.

status.title: Status
status.description: Status is the status of a request.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Priority is the priority of a request as defined by the Octelium Support SLA.

requestedPriority.title: Priority
requestedPriority.description: Priority is the priority of a request as defined by the Octelium Support SLA.

supportLevel.title: Support Level
supportLevel.description: SupportLevel is a support level as defined by the Octelium Support SLA.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Channel is the channel through which a change was made.

reporter.description: Reporter is the person who opened the request.

assignee.description: Assignee is the name of the engineer assigned to the request, if any.

sla.description: SLA is the state of the service level agreement of the request.

isEscalated.description: IsEscalated is whether the request was escalated.

clusterDomain.description: ClusterDomain is the domain of the Cluster from which the request was opened.

environment.description: Environment is the set of the Cluster details that were sent along with the request.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the creation date of the request.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the date of the last change of the request.

lastActivityAt.description: LastActivityAt is the date of the last activity on the request.

resolvedAt.description: ResolvedAt is the date at which the request was resolved.

closedAt.description: ClosedAt is the date at which the request was closed.

messageCount.description: MessageCount is the number of the messages of the request.

attachmentCount.description: AttachmentCount is the number of the files of the request.

events.description: Events is the list of the latest public timeline events of the request, the oldest first. It is not set when listing requests.

eventsCursor.description: EventsCursor is set when the request has earlier events. They are listed via the ListSupportRequestEvent method.

attachments.description: Attachments is the list of the files of the request. It is not set when listing requests.

actions.description: Actions are the actions that are currently allowed on the request. It is not set when listing requests.

portalURL.description: PortalURL is the URL of the request in the customer portal.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.title: Support Request
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.description: SupportRequest is a technical support request with Octelium Support.

canReply.description: CanReply is whether a reply can be added.

canResolve.description: CanResolve is whether the request can be marked as resolved.

canEscalate.description: CanEscalate is whether the request can be escalated.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.title: Actions
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.description: Actions are the actions that are currently allowed on the request.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the author.

name.description: Name is the name of the author, if known.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.title: Actor
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.description: Actor is the author of a change.

id.description: ID is the unique identifier of the file.

name.description: Name is the name of the file.

contentType.description: ContentType is the media type of the file.

size.description: Size is the size of the file in bytes.

sha256.description: SHA256 is the hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of the file, if known.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Purpose is the purpose of the file.

uploadedBy.description: UploadedBy is the author of the file.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Channel is the channel through which a change was made.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the date at which the file was added.

isAvailable.description: IsAvailable is whether the file can still be downloaded. Files are deleted some time after the request is closed.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.title: Attachment
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.description: Attachment is a file of the request.

id.description: ID is the unique identifier of the event.

sequence.description: Sequence is the revision of the request that recorded the event.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the event.

actor.description: Actor is the author of the event.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Channel is the channel through which a change was made.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the date of the event.

body.description: Body is the text of a description, a reply or the name of a new file.

attachmentIDs.description: AttachmentIDs is the list of the files that the event references.

from.description: From is the previous value of a change.

to.description: To is the new value of a change.

reason.description: Reason is the written reason of a change.

skippedAttachments.description: SkippedAttachments is the list of the names of the files that were not accepted.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.title: Event
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.description: Event is a public entry of the timeline of the request.

name.description: Name is the name of the reporter, if known.

isVerified.description: IsVerified is whether the reporter is a verified member of the organization in the customer portal. The reporters of the requests that are opened from a Cluster are never verified.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.title: Reporter
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.description: Reporter is the person who opened the request.

coverage.description: Coverage is the coverage of the response time (i.e. "BUSINESS" for business hours or "CONTINUOUS" for 24/7).

firstResponseDueAt.description: FirstResponseDueAt is the deadline of the first response.

firstRespondedAt.description: FirstRespondedAt is the date of the first response.

isPaused.description: IsPaused is whether the response time is paused because Octelium is waiting on the customer.

nextUpdateDueAt.description: NextUpdateDueAt is the deadline of the next update of Octelium Support.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.title: SLA
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.description: SLA is the state of the service level agreement of the request. It is only set for the requests that are covered by the Octelium Support SLA.
